title: decree check --format json
description: What `decree check --format json` prints on stdout: whether the project is valid, every error, one per line of the text output, and every warning. The exit code is 1 when `errors` is not empty, as in text. `--format sarif` prints the same errors as a SARIF 2.1.0 log instead. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Machine-readable output.

valid.description: True when there are no errors; warnings do not count.

errors.description: Every error, in the order the text prints them: machines by id, then pending migrations, inbox/ and cron/, each by filename.

warnings.description: Files in .decree/graph/ or .decree/schema/ that differ from what `decree graph` or `decree schema` would write. Text prints them on stderr.

error.description: One error: the text line `<file>: <line n | state>: <message> (<rule>)`, in parts.

rule.description: The rule that failed, V1–V21, M1–M3 or E1 (docs/reference/machines.md, Validation), or null for an error no rule names, such as YAML that does not parse.

file.description: The file, relative to .decree/, as in the text: machines/<id>.yml, migrations/<name>.md, inbox/<name>.md or cron/<name>.md.

line.description: The line of the file, when the error names one.

state.description: The dotted path of the state the error is in, when it is inside one.

message.description: What is wrong, without the rule.

warning.description: One warning: the file and what differs.

file.description: The file, relative to .decree/, such as graph/develop.md or schema/v1/machine.schema.json.

message.description: What differs (missing, out of date, or not a file decree writes) and the command that fixes it.
